principle: A metric or operating concept survives only when it changes a useful product, engineering, safety, recovery, or transfer decision. Process activity never earns product-readiness credit.

decisions.reason: It measures accepted end-to-end two-manager capability evidence with fixed capability weights and required evidence layers. It prevents PR/CI/documentation effort from being mistaken for a playable shared journey.
Remote Joining reached accepted 100/100. Preserve its evidence and regression relevance, but do not recalculate it or gate unrelated SSJR work.

The lifecycle concept is useful, but MDP-1 gives design 10% and final product integration only 10%. That overstates design-only maturity and understates the difference between a tested candidate and an integrated product feature.
decisions.migrationRule: Do not rewrite MDP-1 history. Introduce MDP-2 explicitly, backcast the same feature states once, update reporting authority atomically, and preserve SSJR unchanged.

decisions.reason: A percentage encouraged ritualized handoff work and was repeatedly confused with project progress. Context/session-health observations remain useful inputs to ADB and real handoff decisions.
Its five transfer conditions are useful at a real handoff; the 0/20/40/60/80/100 score adds no product or engineering information and can be mistaken for progress.
An adaptive bounded correction/validation budget prevents both runaway fix spirals and premature transfers caused by a universal two-failure stop.
Exact recoverable task/head/hazard state is useful after interruption. Environment scoring, repetitive archival cycles and continuity publication must not become milestones.

Smart Lean Efficient is a useful optimization rule. The historical acronym changed meaning and literal packaging checks caused false failures, so SLE wording/mirror/version rituals must never block product CI.
One compact successor snapshot is valuable at a genuine transfer or recovery boundary. Per-task SNS/VTLS generation duplicates durable state and creates documentation churn.
They duplicate WEC/current task state and consume effort without protecting product behavior.

gateDecisionRule.keepOrStrengthen: Current runtime/UI/data/sync/recovery/security/privacy/provider/cost/release/evidence behavior whose regression would harm the product.
gateDecisionRule.update: A useful product gate that also contains stale narration, fixed topology, completed-milestone score, old PR or handoff coupling; retain the executable invariant and remove the administrative dependency.
gateDecisionRule.archiveManual: Superseded, dormant or rejected architecture, completed milestone provenance, old routing/packaging or historical exact wording whose remaining ideas have active replacement coverage.
gateDecisionRule.delete: Only duplicated generated material with no independent historical, recovery, legal, design or debugging value. Default to archive rather than delete when uncertain.
